context.transcript:
If you're interested in a career in cooking, then consider Estoff Culinary School.
From restaurants to catering businesses to food trucks, our program can help you achieve your goals.
We emphasize healthy cooking using only fresh ingredients.
At Estoff Culinary School, we guarantee job placement upon completion of the program.
Our certificates are recognized by the top chefs in the city.
And by enrolling now, the enrollment fee will be waived.
However, this offer ends on August 1st.
Visit us online or call today.
context.transcript_translation:
如果你对烹饪行业感兴趣，可以考虑 Estoff Culinary School。
从餐厅到餐饮企业再到餐车，我们的课程能帮助你实现目标。
我们强调使用新鲜食材进行健康烹饪。
在 Estoff Culinary School，我们保证完成课程后能找到工作。
我们的证书被城里顶尖的厨师认可。
现在报名，入学费将免除。
不过，此优惠将于 8 月 1 日结束。
请在线访问或致电咨询。
